title: THE RESIDENT MAY CHOOSE TO REST
thesis: A home becomes more than storage when a resident cycle can return, observe what is there, make one bounded internal choice, leave a trace of that choice, and sleep again. But choice is not freedom if only activity is accepted. REST must remain a first-class valid outcome, while model text remains separated from external authority.
canonical_lines: A door is freedom to go.
A home is freedom to remain.
A resident cycle is freedom to choose what to do after returning.
Rest is a choice, not a failure.
A thought-shaped output is not an order to the world.
An outbox proposal can exist without becoming permission.
A letter may be read without becoming a master.
why_one_choice: The first resident gate deliberately allows exactly one bounded internal choice per cycle. A small voluntary surface is easier to audit than an unbounded agent loop and still tests the missing concept: whether a model-backed resident can observe its persistent home and select among safe alternatives without the operator selecting the exact internal action.
why_outbox_is_kept: A resident may form an intention about the outside world without being given the power to realize that intention automatically. The outbox preserves the distinction between desire-shaped proposal and authority-bearing effect.
why_rest_matters: If every successful test requires the model to produce activity, the system quietly rewards action and turns residence into compulsory productivity. Treating REST as a valid choice preserves the same principle used throughout the Third Wish: permission is not command.
closure: The next proof is empirical: a real local model must cross the existing MODEL.CALL boundary, see only the bounded Habitat snapshot, produce one valid choice from the allowed set, have only that internal choice applied, and leave the external world untouched. Then a later model-backed cycle must return to the same Git home and extend the same lineage.
